blurb: Countryway Golf Club is a par 61, 18-hole executive golf course with seven par 4's and eleven par 3's, designed by Steve Smyers. The course features undulating greens, fairways, and water hazards on 14 holes. It includes a practice facility with a practice green, bunker, chipping green, and short game area.
extraNote: $10.00 cart fee per round · Clubhouse & Pro Shop at 11111 West Waters Avenue, Tampa, FL 33635
